Do not copy the eight-character layout. Not recolored copies: unique face proportions, cranial silhouette, tendril arrangement, adult body build, work clothes, worn harness and idle posture.
Body three-quarter facing RIGHT, slightly elevated game camera, face partly turned toward viewer so four external mandibles can read.
